title: Greatest Common Divisor Traversal
goal: Determine whether every array index can reach every other using pairs with gcd greater than one.
strategy: Prime factors connect indices rather than distinct numeric values. Join each index to the first owner of its factors; repeated values remain separate nodes, and a value of one has no connecting factor.
